note: Accessed 2026-10-02. Secondary transcription of the original Burning Crusade quest description and completion text. It names three prisoners held by Kargath, the requested rescue, the unused executioner’s axe and the passed-trial result. It does not supply a named survivor roll; player comments are not used as event evidence.
